nav.offlineNoStops: The bus stops aren't saved on this phone yet. Open the app once with a connection.
nav.offlineNoRoutes: The bus routes aren't saved on this phone yet. Open the app once with a connection, then Bus and train plans offline.
route.tap_stop_app: Tap the stop you're getting off at. The app alerts you two stops before it, even with the screen off.
settings.get_off_note_app: Two stops before you get off or change, the phone buzzes "OFF" in Morse code, beeps and shows a notification, even with the screen off.
bug.pictures_note_app: Up to 3. Screenshot a page takes you to the app: go to the page you want, then tap Screenshot this page. It takes the whole page, top to bottom, and brings you back here. A map may come out blank.
theme.materialYouNote: Turn off for the UwU Apps theme.
migrate.done: Your favourites, places and settings are here from before.
map.locate: to show where you are on the map
map.orbit: Drag to tilt and turn the map
app.myicaNote: Have your MyICA QR code ready for immigration.
terminal.ctrlC: Stop it, or clear the line
tour.terminal.2app: The answers show here. ^C stops one that keeps updating, or clears the line; press and hold to select text and copy it.
tour.terminal.3app: exit, Back or this closes it. Settings, Help and extras opens it again.
map.estimated: No GPS here, so this is an estimate.
reminders.exactAlarms: Android may deliver these reminders late. To get them on time, allow Alarms & reminders for SG Bus Timings.
reminders.leaveTimeHome: Time to leave plans from Home when this phone can't say where you are. Save Home in Places so it always has somewhere to start.
